final_elements.name: right ripple
final_elements.description: One longer broken water ripple below the beak and chest.

visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved square crop contains one thick black rounded head arc facing right, placed high enough to leave room for a body below and behind. Its two separate lower ends are clear attachment anchors for the later back and chest.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the full 3-by-2 raster sheet and each saved square JPG in adjacent order. The head arc and lower attachment ends remain stable; the beak and eye remain on the right, the tail stays left, the wing stays inside the belly, and the two ripples persist through coloring. No temporary guides are used.

transitions.observed_addition: The same open head arc stays high on the right. A two-lobed beak joins its right edge and one black oval eye appears above and behind that joint; both lower head ends remain open.
transitions.instruction_match: The second instruction adds the beak at the head edge and the eye above it. No body or wing arrives early.

transitions.observed_addition: The head arc, right-facing beak, and single eye retain their anchors. A broad back line leaves the left lower head end, rises into one small left tail point, then turns through a low rounded belly to the right lower head end.
transitions.instruction_match: The instruction describes both attachment points and the tail-to-belly sweep; the saved outline has no hidden line through the head.

transitions.observed_addition: The head, eye, beak, left tail point, back and belly stay in their places. One broad open-ended curved wing sits inside the body and one short curved inner stroke appears at its rear.
transitions.instruction_match: The copy asks for a wing inside the existing body and a single short inner feather stroke, matching the two new line jobs without changing the outer silhouette.

transitions.observed_addition: All duck contours and the one inner feather stroke remain. One short teal ripple appears below the tail side and one longer separate teal ripple below the chest side, with white paper between them.
transitions.instruction_match: The step explicitly uses teal marker for two separate broken water marks beneath the established duck, as shown in the saved crop.

transitions.observed_addition: The round head, one eye, two beak lobes, broad body, upturned tail, wing with one inner stroke, and two teal ripples stay in the same positions. Yellow marker fills the duck and orange fills both beak lobes with visible paper streaks.
transitions.instruction_match: The last instruction fills only established shapes and preserves the already teal ripples; no feet, bubble, border, or other new structure appears.
